about: A daily series at 19:00 New York (00:00 UTC the next day) with a day given its own notes and a day deleted, made all-day for all events: the master write is taken and its answer lost, another client gives a day an exception at Google in between (in the new form: Google's master has already changed form, and an old-form id answers 404), then Finish: the plan stands on every day and the exception made since is kept (x-finish, x-identity, x-own, x-agree).
